question: Padma Awardee Sudha Singh is a sports person in which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Athletics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Padma Awardee **Sudha Singh **is related to **Athletics**.
 
• **Sudha Singh **is a renowned** Indian Olympic athlete** specializing in the** 3000-meter steeplechase event**, which falls under the umbrella of athletics.
 
 
• She has won numerous accolades in this field, including gold medals at the Asian Games and Asian Athletics Championships, making her a prominent figure in Indian athletics.
 
• Singh's breakthrough was in the steeplechase, when she took home the **gold medal** at the **2010 Asian Games **in **Guangzhou**.
 
• Since then, she has **represented India at two successive Olympic Games**, in **2012** and **2016**, and earned **gold **at the **2017 Asian Athletics Championships in Bhubaneswar **and
